author: ValWood
body:
**UniProt UniRule (ID and label):**


GO:0016779 | nucleotidyltransferase activity | IEA with UR000160987


**Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC19C2.13c



**Description of issue**

ctu2 is a [tRNA-uridine 2-sulfurtransferase](https://www.pombase.org/term/GO:0103016)

it appears
tRNA-uridine 2-sulfurtransferase = sulfurtransferase
Nucleotidyltransferase = nucleotide group transfer enzyme
title: Incorrect Unirule mapping: GO:0016779	 nucleotidyltransferase activity IEA with UR000160987
